collections.name: Ministry for Culture and Heritage Te Ara Flickr

chosen.method: RETROFITTED to flickrLandingLargest (page-scrape for largest size up to _o original; _b fallback). Originally committed as flickrLargest (_b/1024) at c47ae4e.
chosen.px: up to _o/_4k originals (e.g. 7.8 MP, 2.1 MP) for the subset with bigger originals; _b (1024) for the rest; also FIXES records whose harvested _z/_b secret is stale (HTTP 410)
chosen.urlPattern: largest live.staticflickr.com/<srv>/<id>_<altsecret>_<size>.jpg from the landing page, else _b

collections.notes: *** RETROFITTED (2026-06-06): the original '0/63 exceed 1024' claim was from an UNRELIABLE main-page-JSON scrape that undercounted (large-size URLs are JSON-escaped \/ with alternate secrets). flickrLargest (_b/1024) under-delivered. SWITCHED to flickrLandingLargest (same as SLNSW): scrapes the landing page for _h/_k/_o (up to ~13 MP) with _b fallback. Verified: 4087419821 -> _4k 7.8 MP (where old _z/_b both 410 = broken!), 6686019803 -> _o 2.1 MP (was _b 0.7 MP). Retrofit committed 6cfac9d (shared with the ANMM order-15 add). *** ORIGINAL NOTE: COMMITTED c47ae4e (user-approved 2026-06-06). FIRST non-Recollect collection. object_url=null; large_thumbnail=staticflickr _z (640). Flickr secret rule (confirmed via flickr.com/services/api/misc.urls.html + secondary): _b/_c/_z and all smaller share the photo's BASE secret -> reachable by pure string swap; _h(1600)/_k(2048) need a per-photo ALTERNATE secret, _o needs originalsecret -> only via photo page / getSizes (needs key). Empirical max-size distribution over 63 uniform photos: 0 exceed 1024 (_b 56, _c 4, _z 3) -> >1024 originals vanishingly rare in the Te Ara pool, NOT worth a per-request page scrape (fragile + latency on 100% of requests for ~0% benefit). Flickr never upscales: requesting _b on a sub-1024 original returns the original (safe, never 404). CHOSEN: flickrLargest = swap size token to _b. New reusable platform fn (reusable for the other Flickr collections 12-15, though some may instead use object_url originals). collectionWeights add 0.015 (provisional). build 0; CollectionTester x3 HTTP200 image/jpeg _b (0.79/0.70/0.70 MP vs _z 0.31/0.27/0.27).

collections.notes: *** MAJOR eHive FINDING: unlike the Howick(17) conclusion, eHive runs a PUBLIC IIIF Image API 2.0 service over the master TIFF at iiif.ehive.com, wired to each object page's OpenSeadragon viewer (info: https://iiif.ehive.com/iiif/2/accounts%2f<acct>%2fobjects%2fimages%2f<id>.tif/info.json). /full/full/ returns the full native master as browser JPEG, for EVERY record regardless of rights (47 Public Domain + 3379 All-rights-reserved; the All-rights records serve full native too -- the IIIF endpoint is NOT rights-gated, unlike the _xl/_o suffixes which 500). Transform = drop the _l size suffix from the filename, .jpg->.tif, encode '/'->'%2f'. account 4033. Native distribution (28 uniform): ~14 records 1000px (1.56x over _l 800), ~14 records 1500-4800px (3.5x-36x). One UUID-style id (c3c1be...) handled (single underscore before _l). *** CROSS-FINDING re Howick(17): Howick (account 3000) ALSO has iiif.ehive.com -- tested 4 records, 2 returned 2816x2112 (5.9 MP, ~12x the _l 0.48 MP), 2 had genuine 800px masters. So order 17's committed no-improvement is WRONG for ~half its records -- the IIIF master endpoint bypasses the eHive UI/_xl cap the user saw when logged in. RAISED with user at the approval gate (whether to re-do 17 and apply ehiveIIIFLargest to NZ Portrait Gallery 19). VERIFICATION: swift build 0; CollectionTester x3 HTTP200 image/jpeg (pfsqom_3659 1000x670, 10rf7sh_35r2 1000x669, 12g9vds_1o33 1000x761 -- all 1.56x over _l 800).
